{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "You requested an outfit that is "restrained and classic" for a rock concert, but the provided formality data currently suggests a level of dress ("home") that contradicts the occasion of a club event. To honor your wish to look stylish yet restrained in a crowd at a Friday evening rock show, I have curated a sleek smart-casual ensemble that balances the edgy atmosphere with classic tailoring. This outfit respects your refusal of anything overly casual or loungewear-style while adapting to the artificial indoor lighting and likely cool autumn air. It allows you to stand comfortably in the throng without sacrificing the refined aesthetic you desire.

Structured blazer, tailored fit, midnight navy, wool blend
Slim-leg trousers, high rise, charcoal grey, heavy twill
Leather ankle boots, block heel, black, smooth calfskin
Pearl stud earrings, small diameter, white mother-of-pearl, 925 sterling silver
Thin silk scarf, rectangular, cream with subtle abstract line print, 100% silk

This outfit works because the structured blazer and slim trousers provide a classic, restrained silhouette that anchors the chaotic energy of a rock concert without feeling out of place. The deep midnight navy and charcoal colors are timeless staples that pair effortlessly with the vibrant but unpredictable lighting of a club environment. By choosing a wool blend and heavy twill, you ensure comfort while standing in a crowd during cooler autumn weather, keeping the focus on your clean lines rather than flashy details."}
